mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism and may compete for CYP450 enzymes; perphenazine may potentiate CNS depression and additive endocrine effects; medroxyprogesterone may increase perphenazine levels.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine side effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms); consider dose adjustment of perphenazine if CNS effects emerge; baseline and periodic assessment of metabolic parameters recommended.
